verdict.rationale: A published OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json and code snippets in the docs (gateway config, switching providers via model/apiKey) give the raw material for an API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference UI, runnable in-browser examples, and hands-on corroboration that the reference covers AI Gateway endpoints.
